$description: Creative Force design tokens. Source of truth: Figma qeToOvCArvvSMU3i8rLb4D (Creative Force - Dreem), node 1003-34. W3C DTCG format. Everything in dist/ is generated from this file - never hand-edit dist/.

color.$description: The whole palette. Every value below appears in Figma qeToOvCArvvSMU3i8rLb4D except green and yellow, which are brand-guide state colours - see their descriptions.

blue.$description: The one accent. About three uses per view.

stone.$description: The warm neutral spine. Every CF surface sits on this ramp. Step 500 is the colour the brand guide calls 'Brown'.

500.$description: Brand-guide 'Brown'. Labels and dividers - never running body copy, it fails AA at 14px.

sage.$description: The cool-green counterpart to stone. Illustration and the occasional one-off card, not a general surface.

green.$description: STATE ONLY - positive. There is no brand red; this carries 'good'. Never a surface, never decoration. Absent from the Figma homepage by design.

yellow.$description: STATE ONLY - caution. Same rules as green.

accent.$description: Derived blue interaction states. Darken rule: multiply RGB by ~0.90 then ~0.82.

blue-tint.$description: The only alpha fills in the system. Warm neutrals use the opaque stone ramp instead - alpha compounds where cards stack.

surface.$description: Opaque, always. Reach for a role here before reaching for a ramp step.

card.$description: Cards, and the warm editorial band.

raised.$description: A card sitting on a warm band.

edge.$description: Hairlines, rules, logo-wall gaps, and the grain flood colour.

dark.$description: Footer panel, dark card variants. Never decoration.

muted.$description: A black-ramp shade, deliberately not stone-500. Keeps 14px copy at AA on white and on warm surfaces.

default.$description: Card outlines. A visible rule uses surface.edge instead.

iso-potential.$description: The ghost cube - potential, not yet realised. The illustration language's other three states are stone.100 (before), blue (activated) and black (edges); see BRAND.md.

grain-fade.$description: Transparent warm. The far stop of a fade out of a warm surface - a plain transparent shifts hue on the way.

sans.$value: InterVariable, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
sans.$description: Inter everywhere. Self-hosted variable first; the family is named InterVariable so it cannot collide with a Google Fonts emit.

semibold.$description: Headings. Not 700 - measured in Figma at 44px.

bold.$description: Hero display and article title only.

type.$description: The ladder. Size, weight, line-height and tracking travel together so 44px cannot be applied at the wrong weight.

prose.$description: 16px at 1.6. Long-form article copy ONLY. Marketing modules use type.body at 1.4 - that is what Figma draws.

button.$description: 16px/500, line-height 22px. Buttons are MEDIUM, not semibold - the heavier weight is what made them shout.

stat.$description: 110px. One hero moment per page, never a 4-up strip.

type-fluid.$description: Container-relative sizes. cqi resolves against the module's own container, so a module narrows its own type without a media query. Falls back to the fixed ladder outside a container.

hero.$description: The hero is a distinct display style, not a fork of type.display.

space.$description: 4px base. The gaps are intentional - there is no space-7 because nothing needed 28px twice.

gutter.$description: The page gutter. Fluid so the column breathes between viewports instead of jumping.

max-width.$description: CONTENT width. Gutters are added on top of it, never eaten out of it.

section-pad.$description: The ONE vertical padding formula every full-width section uses. Do not invent variants.

popout.$description: One deliberate step wider than the measure.

feature.$description: A bigger step wider, for media.

radius.$description: Measured from Figma. This is a scale, not one value - the production theme had 12px hardcoded in 13 places alongside a 16px token.

md.$description: Cards. The most common radius in the system.

lg.$description: Large containers, buttons, hero media frames.

pill.$description: Fully round: buttons and badges. Any value past half the height reads the same.

pad-block.$description: Off the 4px scale on purpose - it is what balances 16px/500 text in a pill.

border-width.$description: The secondary button's outline. Heavier than a hairline - it is the whole shape.

underline-offset.$description: Text button rule: 2px thick, 6px below the baseline box, exactly as wide as the text.

shadow.$description: Soft and subtle, or none. Never harsh black.

standard.$description: easeOutQuint. The house curve - reveals, hovers, lifts. Reach for this first.

stagger-max.$description: Cap the ladder at 4 steps (240ms). Past that it reads as lag, not rhythm.

z.$description: Formalised from ad-hoc values that ranged -3 to 9998.

grain.$description: The optional site-wide filmic pass. Distinct from shape grain.
